reasoning: Pink/rose-colored kernel discoloration concentrated at the ear tip (silk channel end, confirmed by visible dried brown silks), with some dark/black kernels in the most severely affected region. This pattern — pink mold starting at the tip via the silk channel — is diagnostic of Gibberella ear rot. Fusarium was ruled out due to lack of scattered distribution and starburst pattern; Diplodia due to wrong color (not white) and wrong location (not base); other ear rots due to wrong mold color.
